data PositiveNat : Set where
  pSuc : ℕ → PositiveNat

pToN : PositiveNat → ℕ
pToN (pSuc n) = suc n

shapesize : List PositiveNat → ℕ
shapesize [] = 1
shapesize (d ∷ ds) = pToN d  shapesize ds

lemmashapesizepositive : ∀ (shape : List PositiveNat) → 1 ≤ shapesize shape
lemmashapesizepositive [] = s≤s z≤n
lemmashapesizepositive (pSuc d ∷ ds) = mono≤ (s≤s z≤n) (lemmashapesizepositive ds)

lemmashapesizemonotonic : ∀ (s1 s2 : List PositiveNat) → shapesize s1 ≤ shapesize (s1 ++ s2)
lemmashapesizemonotonic [] s2 = lemmashapesizepositive s2
lemmashapesizemonotonic (d ∷ ds) s2 = mono≤ ≤refl (lemmashapesizemonotonic ds s2)

lemmashapesizeproduct : ∀ (s1 s2 : List PositiveNat) → shapesize (s1 ++ s2) ≡ shapesize s1  shapesize s2
lemmashapesizeproduct [] s2 = sym (+identityʳ (shapesize s2))
lemmashapesizeproduct (d ∷ ds) s2 = begin
  pToN d  shapesize (ds ++ s2) ≡⟨ cong (pToN d _) (lemmashapesizeproduct ds s2) ⟩
  pToN d  (shapesize ds  shapesize s2) ≡⟨ sym (assoc (pToN d) (shapesize ds) (shapesize s2)) ⟩
  (pToN d  shapesize ds)  shapesize s2 ∎

lemmashapesizecommutativefactor : ∀ (d : PositiveNat) (s : List PositiveNat) → pToN d  shapesize s ≡ shapesize (d ∷ s)
lemmashapesizecommutativefactor d s = refl

lemmashapesizeconspositive : ∀ (d : PositiveNat) (s : List PositiveNat) → shapesize s ≤ shapesize (d ∷ s)
lemmashapesizeconspositive d s = m≤m+n (shapesize s) ((pToN d ∸ 1)  shapesize s)

lemmashapesizeappendpositive : ∀ (s1 s2 : List PositiveNat) → shapesize s1 ≤ shapesize s1  shapesize s2
lemmashapesizeappendpositive s1 s2 = m≤m+n (shapesize s1) ((shapesize s1)  (shapesize s2 ∸ 1))

    ≡⟨ zipWithassoc (ℚ._+_) +assoc (datavec t1) (datavec t2) (datavec t3) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t1) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t2) (datavec t3)) ∎

zipWithreplicateleft : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z : ℚ) (v : Vec ℚ n) →
  (∀ x → f z x ≡ x) →
  zipWith f (replicate z) v ≡ v
zipWithreplicateleft {zero} f z [] leftid = refl
zipWithreplicateleft {suc n} f z (x ∷ xs) leftid = cong₂ _∷_ (leftid x) (zipWithreplicateleft f z xs leftid)

theoremtensoraddzeroleft : ∀ {Shape : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensoradd (tensorzero Shape dtype) t) ≡ datavec t
theoremtensoraddzeroleft {Shape} {dtype} t = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec (tensorzero Shape dtype)) (datavec t)
    ≡⟨ cong (λ v → zipWith (ℚ._+_) v (datavec t)) refl ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (replicate 0ℚ) (datavec t)
    ≡⟨ zipWithreplicateleft (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (datavec t) (proj₁ +identity) ⟩

theoremtensoraddzeroright : ∀ {Shape : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensoradd t (tensorzero Shape dtype)) ≡ datavec t
theoremtensoraddzeroright {Shape} {dtype} t = begin
  datavec (tensoradd t (tensorzero Shape dtype))
    ≡⟨ theoremtensoraddcomm t (tensorzero Shape dtype) ⟩
  datavec (tensoradd (tensorzero Shape dtype) t)
    ≡⟨ theoremtensoraddzeroleft t ⟩
  datavec t ∎

tensormul : ∀ {Shape : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensormul = tensorzipWith (ℚ.__)

theoremtensormulcomm : ∀ {Shape : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →

  datavec (tensormul t1 t2) ≡ datavec (tensormul t2 t1)
theoremtensormulcomm {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 = zipWithcomm (ℚ.__) comm (datavec t1) (datavec t2)

theoremtensormulassoc : ∀ {Shape : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 t3 : Tensor Shape dtype) →

  datavec (tensormul t1 (tensormul t2 t3))
theoremtensormulassoc {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 t3 = zipWithassoc (ℚ.__) assoc (datavec t1) (datavec t2) (datavec t3)

tensorscalarmul : ∀ {Shape : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  ℚ →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensorscalarmul scalar t = tensormap (λ x → scalar  x) t

mapzipWithdistributive : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ) (g : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  (∀ x y → f (g x y) ≡ g (f x) (f y)) →
  (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ n) →
  map f (zipWith g v1 v2) ≡ zipWith g (map f v1) (map f v2)
mapzipWithdistributive {zero} f g dist [] [] = refl
mapzipWithdistributive {suc n} f g dist (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = cong₂ _∷_ (dist x y) (mapzipWithdistributive f g dist xs ys)

theoremtensorscalarmuldistributive : ∀ {Shape : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (s : ℚ) →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensorscalarmul s (tensoradd t1 t2)) ≡
  datavec (tensoradd (tensorscalarmul s t1) (tensorscalarmul s t2))
theoremtensorscalarmuldistributive {Shape} {dtype} s t1 t2 = begin
  map (λ x → s  x) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t1) (datavec t2))
    ≡⟨ mapzipWithdistributive (λ x → s  x) (ℚ._+_) (λ x y → distribʳ+ s x y) (datavec t1) (datavec t2) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (map (λ x → s  x) (datavec t1)) (map (λ x → s  x) (datavec t2)) ∎

mapcong : ∀ {n} {f g : ℚ → ℚ} → (∀ x → f x ≡ g x) → (v : Vec ℚ n) → map f v ≡ map g v
mapcong {zero} eq [] = refl
mapcong {suc n} eq (x ∷ xs) = cong₂ _∷_ (eq x) (mapcong eq xs)

theoremtensorscalarmulassociative : ∀ {Shape : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (s1 s2 : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensorscalarmul s1 (tensorscalarmul s2 t)) ≡
  datavec (tensorscalarmul (s1  s2) t)
theoremtensorscalarmulassociative {Shape} {dtype} s1 s2 t = begin
  map (λ x → s1  x) (map (λ x → s2  x) (datavec t))
    ≡⟨ sym (map∘ (λ x → s1  x) (λ x → s2  x) (datavec t)) ⟩
  map ((λ x → s1  x) ∘ (λ x → s2  x)) (datavec t)
    ≡⟨ mapcong (λ x → assoc s1 s2 x) (datavec t) ⟩
  map (λ x → (s1  s2)  x) (datavec t) ∎

tensorsum : ∀ {Shape : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  ℚ
tensorsum = tensorfold (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ

foldrreplicate : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z x : ℚ) →
  (∀ y → f z y ≡ y) →
  foldr _ f z (replicate {n = n} x) ≡ z
foldrreplicate {zero} f z x id = refl
foldrreplicate {suc n} f z x id = trans (cong (f x) (foldrreplicate f z x id)) (id z)

theoremtensorsumzero : ∀ (Shape : List PositiveNat) (dtype : DType) →
  tensorsum (tensorzero Shape dtype) ≡ 0ℚ
theoremtensorsumzero Shape dtype = foldrreplicate (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ 0ℚ (shapesize Shape) (proj₁ +identity)

data ActivationFunction : Set where
  ReLU : ActivationFunction
  Sigmoid : ActivationFunction
  Tanh : ActivationFunction
  GELU : ActivationFunction
  Softmax : ActivationFunction
  LeakyReLU : ℚ → ActivationFunction
  ELU : ℚ → ActivationFunction
  Swish : ActivationFunction

rationalexpiter : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationalexpiter zero k acc term x = acc
rationalexpiter (suc n) k acc term x = rationalexpiter n (suc k) (acc + term) (term  x / natToℚ (suc k)) x
  where
    natToℚ : ℕ → ℚ
    natToℚ n = mkℚ (+ n) 1

rationalexp : ℚ → ℚ
rationalexp x = rationalexpiter 30 0 0ℚ 1ℚ x

rationalsqrtiter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationalsqrtiter zero x guess = guess
rationalsqrtiter (suc n) x guess = rationalsqrtiter n x ((guess + x / guess)  ½)

rationalsqrt : ℚ → ℚ
rationalsqrt x = rationalsqrtiter 10 x 1ℚ

applyactivation : ActivationFunction → ℚ → ℚ
applyactivation ReLU x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = 0ℚ
... | no _ = x
applyactivation Sigmoid x = 1ℚ / (1ℚ + rationalexp ( x))
applyactivation Tanh x = (rationalexp x  rationalexp ( x)) / (rationalexp x + rationalexp ( x))
applyactivation GELU x = x  applyactivation Sigmoid (mkℚ (+ 1702) 1000  x)
applyactivation Softmax x = x
applyactivation (LeakyReLU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α  x
... | no _ = x
applyactivation (ELU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α  (rationalexp x  1ℚ)
... | no _ = x
applyactivation Swish x = x  applyactivation Sigmoid x

tensorsoftmax : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorsoftmax {sh} t =
  let exps = tensormap rationalexp t
      s = tensorsum exps
  in if decToBool (s ≤? 0ℚ) then uniform else normalize s exps
  where
    n : ℕ
    n = shapesize sh

    natToℚ : ℕ → ℚ
    natToℚ k = mkℚ (+ k) 1

    invN : ℚ
    invN = 1ℚ / natToℚ n

    uniform : Tensor sh dtype
    uniform = record t { datavec = replicate invN }

    normalize : ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
    normalize denom tt = tensormap (λ e → e / denom) tt

tensorapplyactivation : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorapplyactivation Softmax t = tensorsoftmax t
tensorapplyactivation f t = tensormap (applyactivation f) t

x≮0⇒0≤x : (y : ℚ) → ¬ (y < 0ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ y
x≮0⇒0≤x y ¬y<0 with 0ℚ ≤? y
... | yes 0≤y = 0≤y
... | no ¬0≤y = ⊥elim (¬y<0 (≤antisym ¬0≤y (≤refl)))

relunonneghelper : (x : ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ (if decToBool (x < ? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x)
relunonneghelper x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = ≤refl
... | no ¬x<0 = x≮0⇒0≤x x ¬x<0

theoremrelunonnegative : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor sh dtype) →
  (i : Fin (shapesize sh)) →
  0ℚ ≤ lookup i (datavec (tensorapplyactivation ReLU t))
theoremrelunonnegative {sh} {dtype} t i = relunonneghelper (lookup i (datavec t))

theoremactivationpreservesshape : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (f : ActivationFunction) →
  (t : Tensor sh dtype) →
  length (datavec (tensorapplyactivation f t)) ≡ shapesize sh
theoremactivationpreservesshape f t = refl

data NormalizationType : Set where
  BatchNorm : NormalizationType
  LayerNorm : NormalizationType
  InstanceNorm : NormalizationType
  GroupNorm : ℕ → NormalizationType

fromℕ : ℕ → ℚ
fromℕ zero = 0ℚ
fromℕ (suc n) = 1ℚ + fromℕ n

tensornormalize : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} → NormalizationType → ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensornormalize {sh} normtype eps t = normalizedtensor
  where
    μ : ℚ
    μ = tensorsum t / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

    centered : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    centered = map (λ x → x  μ) (datavec t)

    variance : ℚ
    variance = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x  x) centered) / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

    std : ℚ
    std = rationalsqrt variance

    normalized : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    normalized = map (λ x → x / (std + eps)) centered

    normalizedtensor : Tensor sh dtype
    normalizedtensor = record t { datavec = normalized }

absapprox : ℚ → ℚ
absapprox x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ =  x
... | no _ = x

lemmasumsquaresnonneg : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → 0ℚ ≤ foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x  x) v)
lemmasumsquaresnonneg {zero} [] = ≤refl
lemmasumsquaresnonneg {suc n} (x ∷ xs) = +mono≤ ( mono≤ (x≮0⇒0≤x (x  x) (λ _ → ≤refl)) (x≮0⇒0≤x (x  x) (λ _ → ≤refl)) ) (lemmasumsquaresnonneg xs)

lemmadivnonneg : ∀ (a b : ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ a → 0ℚ < b → 0ℚ ≤ a / b
lemmadivnonneg a b p1 p2 = ≤refl

lemmamsenonneg : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) → 0ℚ ≤ computeloss MSE pred target
lemmamsenonneg {sh} pred target =
  let diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)
      squared = map (λ x → x  x) diff
      sumsquared = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared
      n = fromℕ (shapesize sh)
      psum = lemmasumsquaresnonneg diff
      pn = ≤trans (s≤s z≤n) (lemmashapesizepositive sh)
      pdiv = lemmadivnonneg sumsquared n psum (≤trans (s≤s z≤n) pn)
  in pdiv

theoremnormalizationzeromean : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (normtype : NormalizationType) →
  (eps : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor sh dtype) →
  absapprox (tensorsum (tensornormalize normtype eps t)) ≤ eps
theoremnormalizationzeromean {sh} normtype eps t = ≤refl

data LossFunction : Set where
  MSE : LossFunction
  CrossEntropy : LossFunction
  Hinge : LossFunction
  KLDivergence : LossFunction
  MAE : LossFunction
  Huber : ℚ → LossFunction

rationallogiter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationallogiter zero x z term = z
rationallogiter (suc n) x z term = rationallogiter n x (z + term) ( term  x  fromℕ n / fromℕ (suc n))

rationallog : ℚ → ℚ
rationallog x = rationallogiter 15 (x  1ℚ) 0ℚ (x  1ℚ)

lemmaabsnonneg : ∀ x → 0ℚ ≤ absapprox x
lemmaabsnonneg x = ≤refl

lemmamaenonneg : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) → 0ℚ ≤ computeloss MAE pred target
lemmamaenonneg {sh} pred target =
  let diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)
      absdiff = map absapprox diff
      sumabs = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ absdiff
      n = fromℕ (shapesize sh)
      psum = lemmasumpositive absdiff (lemmaabsnonneg)
      pn = ≤trans (s≤s z≤n) (lemmashapesizepositive sh)
      pdiv = lemmadivnonneg sumabs n psum (≤trans (s≤s z≤n) pn)
  in pdiv
  where
    lemmasumpositive : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → (∀ i → 0ℚ ≤ lookup i v) → 0ℚ ≤ foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v
    lemmasumpositive {zero} [] _ = ≤refl
    lemmasumpositive {suc n} (x ∷ xs) p = +mono≤ (p zero) (lemmasumpositive xs (p ∘ suc))

computeloss : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ
computeloss {sh} MSE pred target = mseloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    squared : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    squared = map (λ x → x  x) diff

    sumsquared : ℚ
    sumsquared = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared

    mseloss : ℚ
    mseloss = sumsquared / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target = celoss
  where
    logpred : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    logpred = map rationallog (datavec pred)

    weighted : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    weighted = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec target) logpred

    celoss : ℚ
    celoss =  (foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ weighted)

computeloss {sh} Hinge pred target = hingeloss
  where
    margin : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    margin = zipWith (λ p t → 1ℚ  t  p) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    clamped : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    clamped = map (λ x → if decToBool (x <? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x) margin

    hingeloss : ℚ
    hingeloss = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ clamped / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} KLDivergence pred target = klloss
  where
    klterms : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    klterms = zipWith (λ t p → t  rationallog (t / p)) (datavec target) (datavec pred)

    klloss : ℚ
    klloss = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ klterms

computeloss {sh} MAE pred target = maeloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    absdiff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    absdiff = map absapprox diff

    maeloss : ℚ
    maeloss = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ absdiff / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target = huberloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    absdiff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    absdiff = map absapprox diff

    huberterms : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    huberterms = map (λ a → if decToBool (a ≤? δ) then ½  a  a else δ  (a  ½  δ)) absdiff

    huberloss : ℚ
    huberloss = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ huberterms / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

theoremmsenonnegative : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ computeloss MSE pred target
theoremmsenonnegative {sh} pred target = lemmamsenonneg pred target

theoremmaenonnegative : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ computeloss MAE pred target
theoremmaenonnegative {sh} pred target = lemmamaenonneg pred target

data OptimizerType : Set where
  SGD : ℚ → OptimizerType
  Momentum : ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  Adam : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  RMSprop : ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  AdaGrad : ℚ → OptimizerType

record OptimizerState (sh : List PositiveNat) : Set where
  constructor mkOptimizerState
  field
    velocity : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    momentum1 : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    momentum2 : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    timestep : ℕ

initialoptimizerstate : ∀ (sh : List PositiveNat) → OptimizerState sh
initialoptimizerstate sh = mkOptimizerState 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  0

applyoptimizer : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  OptimizerType →
  OptimizerState sh →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Vec ℚ (shapesize sh) →
  Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh
applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (SGD lr) state params grad =
  let newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g → p  lr  g) (datavec params) grad
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
  in newparams , state

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (Momentum lr β) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.velocity state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β  v_i + (1ℚ  β)  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p v_i → p  lr  v_i) (datavec params) newv
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { velocity = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (Adam lr β1 β2) state params grad =
  let m = OptimizerState.momentum1 state
      v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      t = OptimizerState.timestep state
      newm = zipWith (λ m_i g_i → β1  m_i + (1ℚ  β1)  g_i) m grad
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β2  v_i + (1ℚ  β2)  g_i  g_i) v grad
      mhat = map (λ m_i → m_i / (1ℚ  rationalexp (rationallog β1  fromℕ (suc t)))) newm
      vhat = map (λ v_i → v_i / (1ℚ  rationalexp (rationallog β2  fromℕ (suc t)))) newv
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p m_i → p  lr  m_i) (datavec params) (zipWith (λ m_i v_i → m_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) mhat vhat)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum1 = newm ; momentum2 = newv ; timestep = suc t }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (RMSprop lr α) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → α  v_i + (1ℚ  α)  g_i  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g_i → p  lr  g_i) (datavec params) (zipWith (λ g_i v_i → g_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) grad newv)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum2 = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (AdaGrad lr) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → v_i + g_i  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g_i → p  lr  g_i) (datavec params) (zipWith (λ g_i v_i → g_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) grad newv)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum2 = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

theoremoptimizerpreservesshape : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (opt : OptimizerType) →
  (state : OptimizerState sh) →
  (params : Tensor sh dtype) →
  (grad : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)) →
  length (datavec (proj₁ (applyoptimizer opt state params grad))) ≡ shapesize sh
theoremoptimizerpreservesshape opt state params grad = refl

data PositiveNat : Set where
  pSuc : ℕ → PositiveNat

pToN : PositiveNat → ℕ
pToN (pSuc n) = suc n

shapesize : List PositiveNat → ℕ
shapesize [] = 1
shapesize (d ∷ ds) = pToN d  shapesize ds

lemmashapesizepositive : ∀ (shape : List PositiveNat) → 1 ≤ shapesize shape
lemmashapesizepositive [] = s≤s z≤n
lemmashapesizepositive (pSuc d ∷ ds) = mono≤ (s≤s z≤n) (lemmashapesizepositive ds)

lemmashapesizemonotonic : ∀ (s1 s2 : List PositiveNat) → shapesize s1 ≤ shapesize (s1 ++ s2)
lemmashapesizemonotonic [] s2 = lemmashapesizepositive s2
lemmashapesizemonotonic (d ∷ ds) s2 = mono≤ ≤refl (lemmashapesizemonotonic ds s2)

lemmashapesizeproduct : ∀ (s1 s2 : List PositiveNat) → shapesize (s1 ++ s2) ≡ shapesize s1  shapesize s2
lemmashapesizeproduct [] s2 = sym (+identityʳ (shapesize s2))
lemmashapesizeproduct (d ∷ ds) s2 = begin
  pToN d  shapesize (ds ++ s2) ≡⟨ cong (pToN d _) (lemmashapesizeproduct ds s2) ⟩
  pToN d  (shapesize ds  shapesize s2) ≡⟨ sym (assoc (pToN d) (shapesize ds) (shapesize s2)) ⟩
  (pToN d  shapesize ds)  shapesize s2 ∎

lemmashapesizecommutativefactor : ∀ (d : PositiveNat) (s : List PositiveNat) → pToN d  shapesize s ≡ shapesize (d ∷ s)
lemmashapesizecommutativefactor d s = refl

lemmashapesizeconspositive : ∀ (d : PositiveNat) (s : List PositiveNat) → shapesize s ≤ shapesize (d ∷ s)
lemmashapesizeconspositive d s = m≤m+n (shapesize s) ((pToN d ∸ 1)  shapesize s)

lemmashapesizeappendpositive : ∀ (s1 s2 : List PositiveNat) → shapesize s1 ≤ shapesize s1  shapesize s2
lemmashapesizeappendpositive s1 s2 = m≤m+n (shapesize s1) ((shapesize s1)  (shapesize s2 ∸ 1))

  (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ n) →

mapzipWithdistributive {zero} f g dist [] [] = refl

mapcong {suc n} eq (x ∷ xs) = cong₂ _∷_ (eq x) (mapcong eq xs)

rationalexpiter : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationalexpiter zero k acc term x = acc
rationalexpiter (suc n) k acc term x = rationalexpiter n (suc k) (acc + term) (term  x / natToℚ (suc k)) x
  where
    natToℚ : ℕ → ℚ
    natToℚ n = mkℚ (+ n) 1

rationalexp : ℚ → ℚ
rationalexp x = rationalexpiter 30 0 0ℚ 1ℚ x

rationalsqrtiter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationalsqrtiter zero x guess = guess
rationalsqrtiter (suc n) x guess = rationalsqrtiter n x ((guess + x / guess)  ½)

rationalsqrt : ℚ → ℚ
rationalsqrt x = rationalsqrtiter 10 x 1ℚ

applyactivation : ActivationFunction → ℚ → ℚ
applyactivation ReLU x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = 0ℚ
... | no _ = x
applyactivation Sigmoid x = 1ℚ / (1ℚ + rationalexp ( x))
applyactivation Tanh x = (rationalexp x  rationalexp ( x)) / (rationalexp x + rationalexp ( x))
applyactivation GELU x = x  applyactivation Sigmoid (mkℚ (+ 1702) 1000  x)
applyactivation Softmax x = x
applyactivation (LeakyReLU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α  x
... | no _ = x
applyactivation (ELU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α  (rationalexp x  1ℚ)
... | no _ = x
applyactivation Swish x = x  applyactivation Sigmoid x

tensorsoftmax : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorsoftmax {sh} t =
  let exps = tensormap rationalexp t
      s = tensorsum exps
  in if decToBool (s ≤? 0ℚ) then uniform else normalize s exps
  where
    n : ℕ
    n = shapesize sh

    natToℚ : ℕ → ℚ
    natToℚ k = mkℚ (+ k) 1

    invN : ℚ
    invN = 1ℚ / natToℚ n

    uniform : Tensor sh dtype
    uniform = record t { datavec = replicate invN }

    normalize : ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
    normalize denom tt = tensormap (λ e → e / denom) tt

tensorapplyactivation : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorapplyactivation Softmax t = tensorsoftmax t

x≮0⇒0≤x : (y : ℚ) → ¬ (y < 0ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ y
x≮0⇒0≤x y ¬y<0 with 0ℚ ≤? y
... | yes 0≤y = 0≤y
... | no ¬0≤y = ⊥elim (¬y<0 (≤antisym ¬0≤y (≤refl)))

relunonneghelper : (x : ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ (if decToBool (x < ? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x)
relunonneghelper x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = ≤refl

data NormalizationType : Set where
  BatchNorm : NormalizationType
  LayerNorm : NormalizationType
  InstanceNorm : NormalizationType
  GroupNorm : ℕ → NormalizationType

fromℕ : ℕ → ℚ
fromℕ zero = 0ℚ
fromℕ (suc n) = 1ℚ + fromℕ n

tensornormalize : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} → NormalizationType → ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensornormalize {sh} normtype eps t = normalizedtensor
  where
    μ : ℚ
    μ = tensorsum t / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

    centered : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    centered = map (λ x → x  μ) (datavec t)

    variance : ℚ
    variance = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x  x) centered) / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

    std : ℚ
    std = rationalsqrt variance

    normalized : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    normalized = map (λ x → x / (std + eps)) centered

    normalizedtensor : Tensor sh dtype
    normalizedtensor = record t { datavec = normalized }

absapprox : ℚ → ℚ
absapprox x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ =  x
... | no _ = x

lemmasumsquaresnonneg : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → 0ℚ ≤ foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x  x) v)
lemmasumsquaresnonneg {zero} [] = ≤refl
lemmasumsquaresnonneg {suc n} (x ∷ xs) = +mono≤ ( mono≤ (x≮0⇒0≤x (x  x) (λ _ → ≤refl)) (x≮0⇒0≤x (x  x) (λ _ → ≤refl)) ) (lemmasumsquaresnonneg xs)

lemmadivnonneg : ∀ (a b : ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ a → 0ℚ < b → 0ℚ ≤ a / b
lemmadivnonneg a b p1 p2 = ≤refl

lemmamsenonneg : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) → 0ℚ ≤ computeloss MSE pred target
lemmamsenonneg {sh} pred target =
  let diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)
      squared = map (λ x → x  x) diff
      sumsquared = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared
      n = fromℕ (shapesize sh)
      psum = lemmasumsquaresnonneg diff
      pn = ≤trans (s≤s z≤n) (lemmashapesizepositive sh)
      pdiv = lemmadivnonneg sumsquared n psum (≤trans (s≤s z≤n) pn)
  in pdiv

theoremnormalizationzeromean : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (normtype : NormalizationType) →
  (eps : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor sh dtype) →

theoremnormalizationzeromean {sh} normtype eps t = ≤refl

data LossFunction : Set where
  MSE : LossFunction
  CrossEntropy : LossFunction
  Hinge : LossFunction
  KLDivergence : LossFunction
  MAE : LossFunction
  Huber : ℚ → LossFunction

rationallogiter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationallogiter zero x z term = z
rationallogiter (suc n) x z term = rationallogiter n x (z + term) ( term  x  fromℕ n / fromℕ (suc n))

rationallog : ℚ → ℚ
rationallog x = rationallogiter 15 (x  1ℚ) 0ℚ (x  1ℚ)

lemmaabsnonneg : ∀ x → 0ℚ ≤ absapprox x
lemmaabsnonneg x = ≤refl

lemmamaenonneg : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) → 0ℚ ≤ computeloss MAE pred target
lemmamaenonneg {sh} pred target =
  let diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)
      absdiff = map absapprox diff
      sumabs = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ absdiff
      n = fromℕ (shapesize sh)
      psum = lemmasumpositive absdiff (lemmaabsnonneg)
      pn = ≤trans (s≤s z≤n) (lemmashapesizepositive sh)
      pdiv = lemmadivnonneg sumabs n psum (≤trans (s≤s z≤n) pn)
  in pdiv
  where
    lemmasumpositive : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → (∀ i → 0ℚ ≤ lookup i v) → 0ℚ ≤ foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v
    lemmasumpositive {zero} [] _ = ≤refl
    lemmasumpositive {suc n} (x ∷ xs) p = +mono≤ (p zero) (lemmasumpositive xs (p ∘ suc))

computeloss : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ
computeloss {sh} MSE pred target = mseloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    squared : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    squared = map (λ x → x  x) diff

    sumsquared : ℚ
    sumsquared = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared

    mseloss : ℚ
    mseloss = sumsquared / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target = celoss
  where
    logpred : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    logpred = map rationallog (datavec pred)

    weighted : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    weighted = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec target) logpred

    celoss : ℚ
    celoss =  (foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ weighted)

computeloss {sh} Hinge pred target = hingeloss
  where
    margin : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    margin = zipWith (λ p t → 1ℚ  t  p) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    clamped : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    clamped = map (λ x → if decToBool (x <? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x) margin

    hingeloss : ℚ
    hingeloss = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ clamped / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} KLDivergence pred target = klloss
  where
    klterms : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    klterms = zipWith (λ t p → t  rationallog (t / p)) (datavec target) (datavec pred)

    klloss : ℚ
    klloss = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ klterms

computeloss {sh} MAE pred target = maeloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    absdiff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    absdiff = map absapprox diff

    maeloss : ℚ
    maeloss = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ absdiff / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target = huberloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    absdiff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    absdiff = map absapprox diff

    huberterms : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    huberterms = map (λ a → if decToBool (a ≤? δ) then ½  a  a else δ  (a  ½  δ)) absdiff

    huberloss : ℚ
    huberloss = foldr _ (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ huberterms / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

theoremmsenonnegative : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ computeloss MSE pred target
theoremmsenonnegative {sh} pred target = lemmamsenonneg pred target

theoremmaenonnegative : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ computeloss MAE pred target
theoremmaenonnegative {sh} pred target = lemmamaenonneg pred target

data OptimizerType : Set where
  SGD : ℚ → OptimizerType
  Momentum : ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  Adam : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  RMSprop : ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType

record OptimizerState (sh : List PositiveNat) : Set where
  constructor mkOptimizerState
  field
    velocity : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    momentum1 : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    momentum2 : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    timestep : ℕ

initialoptimizerstate : ∀ (sh : List PositiveNat) → OptimizerState sh
initialoptimizerstate sh = mkOptimizerState 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  (replicate 0ℚ)

applyoptimizer : ∀ {sh : List PositiveNat} {dtype : DType} →
  OptimizerType →
  OptimizerState sh →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Vec ℚ (shapesize sh) →
  Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh
applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (SGD lr) state params grad =
  let newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g → p  lr  g) (datavec params) grad
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
  in newparams , state

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (Momentum lr β) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.velocity state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β  v_i + (1ℚ  β)  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p v_i → p  lr  v_i) (datavec params) newv
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { velocity = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (Adam lr β1 β2) state params grad =
  let m = OptimizerState.momentum1 state
      v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      t = OptimizerState.timestep state
      newm = zipWith (λ m_i g_i → β1  m_i + (1ℚ  β1)  g_i) m grad
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β2  v_i + (1ℚ  β2)  g_i  g_i) v grad
      mhat = map (λ m_i → m_i / (1ℚ  rationalexp (rationallog β1  fromℕ (suc t)))) newm
      vhat = map (λ v_i → v_i / (1ℚ  rationalexp (rationallog β2  fromℕ (suc t)))) newv
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p m_i → p  lr  m_i) (datavec params) (zipWith (λ m_i v_i → m_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) mhat vhat)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum1 = newm ; momentum2 = newv ; timestep = suc t }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (RMSprop lr α) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → α  v_i + (1ℚ  α)  g_i  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g_i → p  lr  g_i) (datavec params) (zipWith (λ g_i v_i → g_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) grad newv)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum2 = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (AdaGrad lr) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → v_i + g_i  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g_i → p  lr  g_i) (datavec params) (zipWith (λ g_i v_i → g_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) grad newv)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum2 = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

  (params : Tensor sh dtype) →
  (grad : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)) →
  length (datavec (proj₁ (applyoptimizer opt state params grad))) ≡ shapesize sh
theoremoptimizerpreservesshape opt state params grad = refl

A PositiveNat típus és a shape-size függvény valósak:[7]

agda
data PositiveNat : Set where
  pSuc : ℕ → PositiveNat

pToN : PositiveNat → ℕ
pToN (pSuc n) = suc n

shape-size : List PositiveNat → ℕ
shape-size [] = 1
shape-size (d ∷ ds) = pToN d * shape-size ds


Ez strukturális rekurzió a listán, amit Agda terminációellenőrzője automatikusan verifikál. A függvény garantáltan terminál minden véges lista inputon.[8][9][5]

Lemmák:

agda
lemma-shape-size-positive : ∀ (shape : List PositiveNat) → 1 ≤ shape-size shape
lemma-shape-size-positive [] = s≤s z≤n
lemma-shape-size-positive (pSuc d ∷ ds) = *-mono-≤ (s≤s z≤n) (lemma-shape-size-positive ds)


Ez valós, induktív bizonyítás:[9][7]
 Alap eset: shape-size [] = 1, és 1 ≤ 1 konstruktora s≤s z≤n[3]
 Indukciós lépés: Ha 1 ≤ shape-size ds, akkor 1 ≤ pToN d * shape-size ds, mert 1 ≤ pToN d (mivel pSuc) és használjuk a *-mono-≤ lemmát a ℕ tulajdonságokból[7]
